title: Cercospora fungal leaf spot disease in eggplants

Monitoring: The infection firstly appears as small light-green spots on the older lowest leaves
Later, spots turn brown and are covered with tiny dark dots of fungal spores
At severe infection, leaves curl and prematurely drop off the plant
Start scouting for symptoms 3 weeks after planting
Do observations twice a week until fruiting starts
Consider control measures when 2-4 plants/10 m 2 have disease symptoms
Direct Control: Remove older lowest leaves from plants to minimize the disease infestation
